hair_features.reason: Short gray temple hair and sideburns plus dark gray-brown eyebrows are retained; the chin is smooth without a moustache, beard or glasses, and exactly one stern closed mouth is present.

entries.positive_observation: The final derivative retains the approved parent RGB art: a yellow compact mascot with green-ringed solid black eyes, source-visible gray temple hair and sideburns, dark gray-brown eyebrows, one stern closed mouth, a smooth chin and no human skin, nose, ears, glasses or facial hair. The dark olive peaked cap retains its shiny black visor, gold braid and oakleaf detailing, an upper gold eagle and a separate lower red-centered gold wreath/cockade. The dark olive uniform retains two gold shoulder boards, two red collar patches with dense gold embroidery, one dark brown diagonal chest strap, one large gold starburst-shaped neck decoration and one small ribbon bar without obvious count duplication. The upright image-right three-quarter pose and gaze, chest crop, warm directional modeling and opaque pale gray-olive/greige backing remain recognizable. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted standing collar with natural contact and no long narrow neck, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. No frame, note or replacement backdrop was invented. Full white/cyan/alpha viewing shows complete opaque backing and clothing without holes, smoke or a working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the repaired RGBA for production. Independent read-only verification confirms source-alpha-resize-bilinear-rgb-unchanged-v1, identical parent/derived RGB pixels, and output alpha exactly matching the BILINEAR-resized source alpha. Source and returned extrema are [255,255]; source, resized and output corner arrays are all [255,255,255,255]. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection confirms that the intended full-canvas backing remains solid with no visible interior transparency or added exterior halo.
entries.visible_limitations: At 156x210 the starburst center, finest cap and collar embroidery and individual ribbon-bar marks cannot be transcribed reliably. Their visible groups, positions and counts were checked without claiming microscopic identity; these limits are not rejection grounds under visible-source-differences-v1.
